claims.text: The retained VSS releases show active evolution of the common vehicle-data model and its tooling, including schema/ID generation, struct support, overlays/profiles, motion-management/health signals and deliberate backward-incompatible cleanup.
claims.context: Synthesis of release notes across major/minor versions.

claims.text: V4.2 adds struct support for DDS IDL generation together with JSON Schema and identifier-generation tooling.
claims.context: Direct release-note entries relevant to typed data contracts and interface generation.

claims.text: V6.0 explicitly documents multiple backward-incompatible signal/unit changes and removal of the OBD branch.

limitations.text: VSS specifies a vehicle-data taxonomy/model and associated tooling; these releases do not by themselves establish a transport protocol, service runtime, or OEM-wide adoption.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of v4.1; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes introduce quantity files/unit syntax updates, new signals and vss-tools support for static IDs and JSON Schema.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of v4.2; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes add new signal areas plus struct support in vspec2ddsidl, a JSON Schema generator and an ID generator.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of v5.0; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes remove UUIDs from standard release artifacts by default, deprecate the OBD branch, improve overlay support and refactor tooling.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of v5.1; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes add/adjust motion-management and seat-related signals and include VSS Extension Profile documentation work.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of v6.0; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes remove the OBD branch, add pattern/default support, change units and several signal definitions including backward-incompatible changes, and add vehicle-health-management signals.

editorial.why_now_note: The series spans late 2023 to early 2026 and shows a common data-contract layer maturing while SDV ecosystems converge on reusable vehicle semantics.
editorial.rationale: Strong data-contract candidate that complements middleware/network evidence and makes the service/data separation explicit.
